subject: Request: credits & trial extension for ethics-approved anonymization pipeline
messages:
From: Dr. Amina Yusuf <amina.yusuf@ghdc.ke>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samuel Ouma <sam.ouma@ghdc.ke>
Date: 2026-10-11 09:12 +03:00
Subject: Request: credits & trial extension for ethics-approved anonymization pipeline

Hi Kimberly,

Thank you for the quick onboarding last week — the demo of the prefix-caching options was really helpful. I’m writing from the Global Health Data Cooperative (GHDC) with a time-sensitive ask: our institutional ethics board has approved a small-scale study that uses your realtime anonymization/embedding flow, but the grant timeline requires us to finish pilot runs and submit the final protocol appendices to the board by Oct 31.

We are running into two constraints:
- Our initial free trial allocation will be exhausted within a few days due to larger-than-expected token volumes during de-identification iterations.
- The project needs an additional 45-60 days of a trial environment with the same model variant and data-residency settings to finish QA and produce reproducible logs for the board.

Attached: ethics_board_statement.pdf (approval letter) and data_schema.csv (PII fields we’re redacting). Can Redwood provide a one-off research-topup of credits (estimate: ~25k tokens) and a 60-day trial extension scoped to the GHDC project? We’re happy to sign a short MOU and provide the signed protocol. Also: quick question — do you offer per-project residency (EU/US) options for trial instances? Our participants are in Nairobi and some partner sites in East Africa.

Appreciate any help, and open to a brief call this week if that helps.

Best,
Amina
Dr. Amina Yusuf
Research Director, Global Health Data Cooperative
Attachments: ethics_board_statement.pdf, data_schema.csv
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Amina Yusuf <amina.yusuf@ghdc.ke>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11 12:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: credits & trial extension for ethics-approved anonymization pipeline

Hi Amina — thanks for the clear note and congrats on the ethics approval. I’ve looped in Marcus from Growth (for credits / MOU) and Rishi from Security (for SOC2/residency questions). Priya is on the account team and will help with operational steps.

Quick answers up front:
- We can usually provision limited research top-ups for approved academic/nonprofit pilots.
- Trial extension requests are evaluated against security/compliance and capacity; a 60-day scoped extension is often possible with a short MOU and SOC2 evidence.
- Residency: our Private deployment options can be scoped to regions, but for hosted trials we can pin a region where available — Rishi will advise on the constraints.

Marcus/Rishi — could you advise on an initial token top-up and any paperwork required? Amina — if you can send the signed protocol and a single paragraph describing the residency requirement (e.g., prefer EU/US/other), that will speed approval.

I can also set up a 20-minute call Thurs if helpful.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Growth Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Amina Yusuf <amina.yusuf@ghdc.ke>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12 09:47 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: credits & trial extension for ethics-approved anonymization pipeline

Hi Amina — glad to hear the approval, and thanks Kimberly. I’m able to approve a one-off research top-up of 25,000 token-equivalent credits and a 60-day trial extension scoped to the GHDC project, contingent on:

1) A short MOU (two paragraphs) confirming use for research and no PII retention beyond the anonymization window. We have a template we can DocuSign.
2) Receipt of the SOC2 summary or redacted audit excerpt (for initial approval) — this can be a single-page PDF.

Operational notes:
- Temporary credit allocation: we’ll apply the top-up to the project namespace you are using; if you hit the limit we’ll notify you 3 days before throttling.
- Overages: for research pilots we typically bill overages to a card on file or pause the trial; if billing is an issue we can discuss a small grant invoice route.

I’ve created a short DocuSign link for the MOU: https://app.docusign.com/edu-trial-topup/ND-8321 (expires in 7 days). Once signed and we have the SOC2 summary, I’ll push the credits and enable the 60-day extension.

Deal reference for internal tracking: EDU-2026-423.

— Marcus Lin
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: trial_topup_agreement.docx (DocuSign link active)
From: Dr. Amina Yusuf <amina.yusuf@ghdc.ke>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samuel Ouma <sam.ouma@ghdc.ke>
Date: 2026-10-13 14:22 +03:00
Subject: Re: Request: credits & trial extension for ethics-approved anonymization pipeline

Hi Marcus / Kimberly — thank you, this is great news. I’ve completed the DocuSign MOU and attached the signed protocol here (signed_protocol.pdf).

Two quick follow-ups:
- We will not retain raw PII in our project bucket beyond the anonymization run; we redact and store only the de-identified outputs.
- Residency: for now we only need EU residency for logging and key management due to a partner site requirement (Can you confirm if the 60-day trial can be pinned to an EU-backed instance?).
- If we exceed the top-up, what’s the simplest route to avoid any interruption? Can we put a small purchase order in or provide a grant chart to be invoiced?

Appreciate the help — if any of you want to hop on a 15 min call Mon morning Nairobi time I’m available.

Best regards,
Amina
Attachments: signed_protocol.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Amina Yusuf <amina.yusuf@ghdc.ke>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-15 16:27 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: credits & trial extension for ethics-approved anonymization pipeline

Hi all — quick security note from my side. Thanks for sharing the ethics letter and protocol. For the scoped trial we require:

- A one-page SOC2 summary or equivalent — that’s sufficient for provisioning the extension. (See attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf from our side to show the control baseline.)
- A short security checklist (I can run this with Amina in 15 minutes) to confirm that keys and logs are scoped appropriately and no raw PII is retained.
- For EU residency: we can pin the trial to an EU-backed namespace for logging; however, model inference may still route through optimized endpoints depending on capacity. If strict data-residency is required we can offer a Private deployment eval (short lead time) — Priya can follow up on options and cost.

Marcus — once Amina confirms the MOU is completed and we have the signed protocol, I’m comfortable endorsing the 60-day extension and Marcus can push the 25k credits. Amina — I’ll send a calendar invite for a 15-minute security check unless you prefer email.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Lead, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf
